reviews.text: If I could give this 10 stars, I would! Skyler Clawson was more than just friendly, he was invaluable in helping me navigate homeowners insurance claims and getting my property repaired and even upgraded. The work was done quickly and professionally. They made my hail damage experience easy and stress free.
reviews.author: Texas Lady

reviews.text: We had a really hard time finding someone that would actually show up to look at our roof for insurance replacement. The others were going to do our roof for less than our deductible but never explained how that's possible or legal. Then we found Johnny Walker roofing. We knew the decking was original from 1953 and probably bad. These guys arrived at 630a within 2 hours it was confirmed this was a full replacement to the rafters. I'm not sure anyone else would have actually replaced the decking. From 630a-4p we had one crew working. Around 4pm two other crews arrived after already working other jobs. They left at 10p and got back next day at 630a and were finished by lunch. My yard was left cleaner than they started. Since we've never experienced anything like this we've had lots of follow up questions and concerns. These guys didn't care if we asked dumb questions or intelligent questions they answered without attitude or making us feel like we shouldn't question them. I'm not sure if the photos really show how much work had to be done. Our new roof is the brown the old is the white. Thank you so much.
reviews.author: Wisest Crow

reviews.text:
Johnny Walker Roofing and Construction did a phenomenal job from start to finish. Walker and his team went above and beyond to ensure we were satisfied and at ease throughout the entire process.

After multiple hail and windstorm inspections, our insurance adjuster told us three different times that the damage only required patching and that the cost was less than our deductible—meaning nothing would be covered. That all changed when Walker, who was highly recommended by a dear friend, stepped in. Through the appraisal process, he ensured our claim was properly reviewed, and we were approved for a brand-new roof. I was ecstatic!

From that point on, Walker was incredibly kind, patient, and thorough—always taking the time to answer my questions and explain each step along the way. On installation day, his team arrived by 6:30 a.m. and had everything completed, including cleanup, before 4:00 p.m.

I 110% recommend Johnny Walker Roofing and Construction. Thank you again, Walker, for everything!
reviews.author: Liliana Trevino

reviews.text: Awesome up and coming roofing company! We had a leak near the chimney and they were able to quickly come by for an evaluation around our schedule. After looking at the roof there was hail damage found. They were able to walk us through the process of filing a claim with our insurance company and what to expect. They even met our adjuster to ensure our claim was fully communicated. From there it was seamless. As soon as the claim was processed they got right to work. Josh was great and ensured all contractor schedules and work was performed as planned and took great care to ensure no debris was left behind. Walker was great helping us with a small piece of flashing that needed adjustment. All we paid was our deductible. First time filing a claim and we couldn’t be happier with the results. It’s like we have a brand new house!
reviews.author: Caiti Dowden

reviews.text:
I needed my roof repaired and with Skyler’s help I was able to get the whole roof replaced by insurance. He helped me with an adjuster and then walked me through the appraisal process to get a new roof.
Skyler was very helpful throughout the whole process and kept things moving. The install was quick and well done once the approval was received. I’m glad he stopped by that afternoon and I’m very grateful for his help. Johnny Walker Roofing and Construction did a great job!
reviews.author: Heather Libick

reviews.text: Walker has been amazing to deal with! I bought a new house and there were no gutters installed which was leaving my foundation at risk. They were so quick to come out, quote the job (SUPER FAIR PRICING!) and the work was completed within just a few days of the estimate! I also had a loose shingle on the roof that Walker noticed upon inspection and he fixed that up too. Next project with Johnny Walker is my fence install for a larger gate. They truly do it all and are fast, reasonably priced and professional.
reviews.author: Nichole McCloy

reviews.text:
It has been a little over a year since I had my roof replaced by Johnny Walker Roofing & Construction, and we haven't had any problems—no leaks, broken shingles, or issues of any kind.
When Walker Carrell first approached me, I had already been getting the runaround and cold shoulder from another company. I'm so glad that company never actually signed a contract with me, because it allowed JWR&C to take care of my home instead.
From that first introduction, Walker was friendly, courteous, and genuinely cared about me and my family. He kept me informed every step of the way. We sat down together for the initial phone call with the insurance company, he was onsite throughout the entire installation, and he even brought his kiddo out just to say hi!
This company has changed my perspective on what customer service is and how it should be delivered. If you're in need of a roof inspection, give Johnny Walker Roofing & Construction a call. You won't regret it!
reviews.author: Jesse Landin

reviews.text: Super great company to work with! Skyler was really helpful and gave us multiple options to fix our leaky roof quickly. They completed the work quickly and cleaned up really well when they finished the job. Skyler was very patient with me while we figured out what we were going to do (while also figuring out a couple other emergency home repairs) and made sure they scheduled us before the next rain!! Thank you!!
reviews.author: Sierra Hardy

data.summary: Reviews show strong authentic signals with specific details and varied writing styles. The 5.0 rating with 157 reviews is plausible for a quality roofing contractor. However, the complete absence of any negative reviews in the sample (8/8 perfect) and similar narrative patterns raise minor concerns about potential review curation.
fake_signals: All 8 sampled reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Multiple reviews mention same employee names (Skyler, Walker)
Some reviews have similar narrative structure (insurance claim help)

positive_evidence: Review mentions no problems after a year - 'no leaks, broken shingles, or issues of any kind'

authentic_signals: Specific project details (1953 decking, chimney leaks, gutter installation)
Mention of specific employees and processes
